rationales: © is the symbol for copyright.
ⓔ is a circled letter e, not the copyright symbol.
$ is the dollar sign.
® is the registered trademark symbol.
.doc is commonly used for Word documents.
.xls is commonly used for Excel spreadsheets.
.ppt is commonly used for PowerPoint presentations.
.html is the file extension used for HTML pages.
DHCP does not stand for Data Hosting Computer Protocol.
DHCP does not stand for Data Host Configuration Protocol.
DHCP does not stand for Dynamic Host Computer Protocol.
DHCP stands for Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol.
Valid test data checks expected inputs, not specifically the extremes.
Invalid test data checks inputs outside the acceptable range.
Boundary test data checks values at the extremes or limits.
Absent data tests what happens when input is missing.
Four bytes are not the minimum required to store a piece of information.
Three bytes are not the minimum required to store a piece of information.
Two bytes are not the minimum required to store a piece of information.
One byte is the minimum amount given for storing a piece of information.
A client system alone does not include the server role.
Web browsers act as clients and web servers provide services in a client-server system.
A server system alone does not include the client role.
Computer system is too general; the specific model is client-server.
Input is usually shown with a parallelogram.
A terminal symbol is usually an oval or rounded rectangle.
A diamond represents a decision in a flowchart.
Output is usually shown with a parallelogram.
Start marks the beginning of an algorithm rather than checking a condition.
If-else checks a condition and selects a course of action.
Set assigns a value rather than checking a condition.
Goto transfers control rather than checking a condition.
0–10 includes 10, which is not a decimal digit.
1–10 omits 0 and includes 10, which is not a digit.
The decimal system uses the digits 0 through 9.
1–9 omits the decimal digit 0.
A OR False is not always 0; it depends on A.
A OR False is not always 1; it depends on A.
By the identity law, A OR False equals A.
All of these cannot be correct because the result is A.
Parentheses do not enclose HTML tags.
Square brackets do not enclose HTML tags.
HTML tags are enclosed in angle brackets.
Braces do not enclose HTML tags.
Protocols can specify authentication procedures.
Protocols can specify methods for error detection.
Protocols can specify methods for correcting errors.
Protocols can cover authentication, error detection, and correction.
The receiver must be able to accept the message being sent.
A protocol is a set of communication rules, not the item the receiver accepts.
An address identifies a destination but is not the main item being accepted.
Information is a broad term; the communication item is specifically the message.
Six characters is shorter than the commonly required minimum of eight.
Eight characters is the expected minimum password length.
Ten characters is not the specified minimum in this question.
Twelve characters is not the specified minimum in this question.
A password is a secret credential, not a human-verification test.
A signature line is used for signing, not for verifying that a user is human.
Verification is a general process, not the name of this test.
CAPTCHA is a challenge used to distinguish human users from automated programs.
